full_prompt_en: A square cinematic black-and-white close portrait shows a curly-haired man from the shoulders upward, turned toward the image right. His head occupies most of the center, with loose dark curls sweeping across the top and left and disappearing into a black background. He lifts his gaze slightly above the horizon, jaw set and lips held together, giving the still pose a determined, inward-looking mood. Strong light catches the upper forehead, ridge of the nose, cheekbone, and front edge of the jaw. Heavy shade cuts through the eye socket, under the cheek, and across the neck, leaving the face readable through dramatic alternation of light and dark planes. Fine skin texture and slight creases remain in the lit cheek and brow. The visible ear sits just left of center under the hair, partly separated from the surrounding darkness by a slim gray highlight. A dark coat and striped collar appear at the lower edge, where the shoulder blends into near-black. The background on the right is a soft smoky gray with faint diagonal light streaks, but contains no identifiable setting. The left outer side stays nearly black, giving the profile an uneven, open field to face. The camera angle is close and a little below eye level, strengthening the lifted direction of the head. A bright source above and to the image right creates the pale facial ridge, while reflected light only weakly reaches the lower side. The overall composition is spare and monumental, using sculptural side light and empty gray space to turn a single upward glance into a charged cinematic image.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形电影式黑白近景肖像呈现一位卷发男子的肩部以上形象，头转向画面右侧。头部占据中央大部，松散深卷发横过上方与左侧，并隐入黑背景。他的目光略高于水平线，下颌紧绷、嘴唇合拢，使静止姿态带有坚定而内向的气息。强光照亮额头上部、鼻梁、颧骨和下颌前缘。厚重阴影切过眼窝、面颊下方和颈部，使脸靠明暗平面的戏剧性交替保持可辨。受光的面颊与眉部仍有细肤理和浅皱纹。可见耳朵位于中央略左、头发之下，一道细灰光把它部分从周围黑暗中分开。下边缘露出深外套与有条纹的衣领，肩膀在那里融入近黑色。右侧背景是柔和烟灰色，有隐约斜向光纹，但没有可辨环境。左侧外缘几乎全黑，为侧面朝向提供不均衡的开阔空间。相机很近，略低于眼平，使头部上抬的方向更强。右上方明亮光源塑出浅色面部棱线，反射光只微弱地到达下侧。整体构图简练而显宏大，利用雕塑般侧光与空旷灰域，把一次抬眼变成充满张力的电影画面。
style_prompt_en: The image has a dramatic cinematic monochrome finish, with sculptural pale ridges emerging from broad near-black masses. A slightly smoky gray field opens on one side, while curls and lower shapes dissolve into the darker opposite side. The focal edge is crisp under strong light, but soft grain and muted transitions remain inside the midtones. Subtle diagonal streaks in the atmosphere echo the direction of the illumination without defining a setting. A high side source strikes projecting planes and allows recessed areas to fall sharply away. Tight cropping enlarges simple forms and makes small shifts of gaze or contour feel consequential. The overall effect is sparse, weighty, and charged, built on uneven space and disciplined contrast.
style_prompt_zh: 画面呈现戏剧性的电影式单色完成面，雕塑般的浅亮棱线从宽阔近黑体块中浮出。一侧展开略带烟雾的灰色底域，卷曲线条和下部形体在较暗对侧消失。受强光的焦点边缘清楚，中间调内部仍有柔颗粒和克制过渡。空气中细微斜纹呼应受光方向，却没有界定具体环境。高位侧光打在突出的平面上，使凹处快速坠入暗部。紧密裁切放大简单形状，让目光或轮廓的微小变化显得重要。整体效果稀疏、沉重而带张力，建立在不均衡空间和有纪律的反差上。
theme_en: A dramatic monochrome side portrait of a curly-haired man looking upward
theme_zh: 卷发男子抬头望向右方的戏剧性黑白侧面肖像
name: Christopher Nolan
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
